Message.En: [Door of Gemstones] Howls of the Beasts

[Dangerous Area Quest] Make a key to the
door leading to the Dangerous Area in
the dungeon and defeat Brutal monsters.
Message.Jp:
【危険区域クエスト】
ダンジョン内の危険区域へ繋がる扉の鍵を作り
凶悪な魔物を討伐する

Message.En:
Within the
<NAME AREA>
dungeon,
there is a place that only those who
possess a special key can enter.
Message.Jp:
<NAME AREA>のダンジョン内部は、特別な
鍵を持った者だけが入れる場所があるらしい

Message.En:
Recently, it seems a strange monster has
taken up residence in the newly opened
rest area.
Apparently, it loves beautiful stones
and shiny objects. It's rather arrogant
for a monster. They say it's quite
ferocious, but if we can defeat it, we
might get something really valuable
in return.
Message.Jp:
最近開いた休憩所に、変な魔物が棲みついたらしい
なんでも、綺麗な石だとか光物が好きなんだって
魔物のくせに、生意気だよ
相当凶暴だって話だけど
倒せたら、相当良い物が手に入るかも？
遭遇した凶悪な魔物を討伐する
